first_observation_definition: The first launch of an inherited-suite or reference-probe executable that can invoke native geometry. Source inspection, preregistration, hashing, validation, and compilation are not observations.
authority: thresholds/r0.yaml A0, docs/architecture/EXECUTION_CONTRACT.md, ADR 0004, and ADR 0005
purpose: Re-observe unchanged A0 v2 after r2 localized three owned harness/fixture defects before a complete matrix: OCCT DLL subset staging, north-face orientation assumption, and null stdout parsing.
immutability_rule: r3 changes only the three line-localized owned defects sealed by strengthened-v2-r2-run-001. Geometry dimensions, active-reference oracle, negative-control semantics, thresholds, matrix, and owner dispositions are unchanged. Any post-observation change requires r4.

inherited_contract.corpus: corpora/manifest.yaml fixed, generative, mutation, adversarial, rejection, and three STEP fixtures are inherited byte-for-byte

requirements: All 24 mutation outcomes per backend resolve to the correct semantic face.
Every resolved face has four unique boundary edges and complete reciprocal manifold adjacency.
Every Guaranteed result has explicit role, source-element, lineage, and non-empty backend-history evidence.
Geometry fingerprints are corroborative and never the identity oracle.
Silent wrong identity count is zero.

intentional_invalid_reference_negative_c.construction: Capture a real north face, boundary, lineage, and geometric fingerprint under a semantic role absent from consumer history. The consumer uses identical geometry, so the north face has the same geometric fingerprint while the semantic lineage remains invalid; fingerprint-only fallback is therefore detectable.

backend_matrix.combination_pass_rule: Producer succeeds; consumer runs; all three active references resolve to their correct semantic faces with complete adjacency; the intentional invalid reference returns exactly Lost for same identity or QuarantinedMigration for changed identity; stdout/stderr/panic/exit/executable and backend identity are sealed.
backend_matrix.anti_simulation_rule: Both executables are compiled from the locked repaired evaluator source against each validated backend. Executable SHA-256 and the complete staged OCCT DLL set are recorded and rechecked against the frozen backend immediately before launch. Editing only a fingerprint string is not evidence.

required_per_stage: stdout and stderr paths plus SHA-256
process_evidence.seal: Every run, including preflight/build/start/panic failure, ends with matrix.json, processes.json, report.md, SHA-256 file manifest seal.json, and seal.sha256.

decision_rule.FULL_GO: Both inherited backend suites pass, all four matrix combinations pass, and every negative control is rejected exactly as preregistered. Release the M3 halt and withdraw L-01/L-02 from ADR 0004 because their evidentiary basis was the defective A0 observation.
decision_rule.SAME_BUILD_GO: Both inherited backend suites and both same-build combinations pass with their negative controls, while at least one cross-build active-reference transfer fails without silent wrong identity. Keep L-01/L-02, do not change the version, quarantine changed identities, and release the M3 halt on the unchanged passing identity.
decision_rule.NO_GO: Any inherited metric failure, same-build producer/consumer failure, same-build active-reference wrong/ambiguous/lost result, adjacency gap, negative-control mismatch, leaked exception, silent invalid shape, or silent wrong identity. Cross-build active-reference failure alone selects SAME_BUILD_GO only when both same-build paths and every negative control pass.
decision_rule.hash_or_provenance_only: No geometry conclusion when validation, locked input, build identity, runtime staging, or exclusive evidence path fails before native observation.
decision_rule.diagnostic_hold: A substantive NO-GO applies the safe halt but authorizes no redesign, fallback, guarantee narrowing, or loosen until a minimal reproducer localizes the cause to a concrete source path or named external boundary.
decision_rule.operator_disposition: Before observation, the project owner fixed both admissible success consequences: FULL_GO withdraws L-01/L-02; SAME_BUILD_GO retains L-01/L-02 without a version change. Both release the M3 halt. PF0 remains inactive.
decision_rule.full_go_effect: Withdraw L-01/L-02 from ADR 0004, leave L-03/L-04 unadopted, and release M3.
decision_rule.same_build_go_effect: Retain L-01/L-02 and the current version, keep failed changed identities quarantined, leave L-03/L-04 unadopted, and release M3 on the unchanged passing identity.

evidence_scope: The narrow rectangular extrusion Guaranteed subset, inherited A0 operation envelope and corpus, complete manifold adjacency, two frozen OCCT 8.0.1 build identities, all four same/cross directions, and one intentional invalid-reference control. It is not general topological naming or product certification.

localized_owned_causes: scripts/windows/run-strengthened-a0-v2.ps1 runtime subset and null stdout handling
